entities.summary: Caroline Rose Harvey is an American college ice hockey defenceman for Wisconsin and member of the United States women's national ice hockey team. Widely regarded as one of the best defensemen in the world, Harvey was named Best Defenseman at the 2023 and 2025 World Championships, becoming only the second defenseman in history to lead the United States in points at an Olympics or World Championship.
